children: Williams Robert Kirk, an officer serving as Chief People & Intl Officer, reported a sale of common stock at a weighted average price of $48.7654 per share. Following the transaction, the reporting person directly beneficially owns 44,353 shares, which include 20,000 shares held directly, 22,174 restricted stock units, and 2,179 earned performance share units with additional service-based vesting.
